verdict.rationale: Multi-channel listing is a fair question for an ecommerce platform like Swell, but the evidence pack never mentions marketplace, social-commerce or shopping-feed integrations. What it does show (CSV export, webhooks, serverless functions calling external APIs) are developer building blocks or adjacent features, and the 'single catalog' claim covers wholesale and retail, not external channels. None of these earn credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can list and sync products to external channels — marketplaces, social commerce, shopping feeds — from one catalog
